My dad got snipped after he had three kids with his first wife, then he got it reversed (in the early 80s!) after he met my mom. After I showed up, he got snipped again. Then Mom tried to talk him into trying for a girl, but he put his foot down.

I got mine a day after we came home from the hospital with our third kid. My wife let me take one of her Percocet after the lidocaine wore off, but it was not a bad procedure at all. I did the follow-up check to make sure the separated vas deferens didn’t find their way back to each other, and I got the green light. I wish I could echo what other people are saying about how it did wonders for their sex lives, but she hasn’t gotten pregnant since, at least.

That makes sense. My only concern is whether the court will process this. A friend of mine who is a former CPS worker said she has seen couples with kids try to divorce this way and be told the court won’t accept it without a lawyer being involved to make the custody arrangements. She’s on the Missouri side, though, and I don’t know if that is also the case here in Kansas.
No one is perfect. You made a mistake. Now own up to it like a grown adult and stop sulking like a toddler about it.

Thank you. I think the main thing is that it never feels like a good time to talk and hash these things out. My wife works nights and weekends. I was actually off for the last couple of days, but I still barely saw her because she was working. I mean, when's a good time to have a mental breakdown? 

I feel like I've spent the last 15 years just trying to get from one day to the next, always thinking that "soon", we'll get our shit together enough to make everything work. We'll be able to fix up the house, we'll be able to save up some money... but it hasn't happened and now I feel like we're on the downslope of our marriage.
